question: Where is the sky-mover doctrine said to be taught?
premises: one solely relishing devouring time becomes a sky-mover by himself
that is said by the supreme lord
it is said in the tantra named śrīḍāmara
inference: the sky-mover result is taught by the supreme lord in the śrīḍāmara tantra
plain_english: One solely relishing the devouring of time becomes a sky-mover by himself; that is said by the supreme lord in the tantra named śrīḍāmara.
